commands: echo '=== EFS Connectivity and TLS Mount Probe ==='
nc -zv ${DATA_EFS_ID}.efs.${REGION}.amazonaws.com 2049 >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'Data EFS port 2049 reachable' || echo 'Data EFS port 2049 NOT reachable'
nc -zv ${APP_EFS_ID}.efs.${REGION}.amazonaws.com 2049 >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'App EFS port 2049 reachable' || echo 'App EFS port 2049 NOT reachable'
mount -t efs -o tls ${DATA_EFS_ID}:/ /mnt/efs/probe && echo 'TLS mount (data) OK' || echo 'TLS mount (data) FAILED'
mount -t efs -o tls ${APP_EFS_ID}:/ /mnt/efs/probe && echo 'TLS mount (app) OK' || echo 'TLS mount (app) FAILED'
